links.outcome: LLM surgical recommendation quality and safety risk by case complexity
links.effect: Gemini appropriateness and rationale quality dropped significantly in complex cases with increased safety risk (p = .009); ChatGPT and Copilot rationale quality lower in complex cases (p = .014, <0.001).
links.quote: For Gemini, appropriateness and rationale quality scores dropped significantly in complex cases and were accompanied by a statistically significant increase in safety risk (p = .009).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance, rationale quality, and safety risks of three LLMs on clinical glaucoma vignettes without testing a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
